label: late original-phase / <DEL> steps in sequences starting with 0/o/w/i/a, on inputs h,3,s,r,k,f,b,<DEL>
predicate: (phase <= 1) & (t >= 4) & isin(first_tok, [tok("0"), tok("o"), tok("w"), tok("i"), tok("a")]) & isin(in_tok, [tok("h"),tok("3"),tok("s"),tok("r"),tok("k"),tok("f"),tok("b"),30])
explanation: Fires only during the original phase from step ~3 onward and at the <DEL> step (80%/20% of mass); never at t<=1 and never in the copy phase. Rate rises with orig_idx (0.6% at idx 3 to 8% at idx 8) and with L. Within that window it is strongly modulated by the first original token (0, o, w give ~4-5x lift; i, a ~2.7x) and by the current input (h strongest at 5.7x, then 3, s, r, <DEL>, k, f, b). Top activations are h/3/s inputs or <DEL> late in sequences beginning with 0/o/w. Prefers first occurrences of the input token. The window alone (phase<=1, t>=4) gives 95% recall at 3.5% precision; adding first-token and input-token conditions gives F1 ~0.32 on dev, so the selection within the window looks like a distributed mix of token identities and is only partly captured.
